label: GO after an unrewarded common a2->S2 trial
explanation: Fires only at GO (100% of mass), and only when the previous trial was unrewarded (prev_reward == 0, 100% of mass). It never fires at D1 or D2, or after a rewarded trial. Most of the mass (77%) comes after the previous trial was a common a2->S2 transition that went unrewarded, which is evidence against S2 and pushes toward a1. Precision is low (0.24) because the unit stays below threshold on many such GOs, especially when S2 is actually the good state. Adding good != 2 or a mid-range value (7.1-8.1) raises dev F1 only to about 0.43. Firing is also more frequent on upcoming switches (stay == 0, about 5x lift) and in mid-episode trials 20-79, and it is absent in trials 90-99. These look like magnitude modulators of a graded signal rather than a clean extra condition. The predicate uses only observed history.
